body.content: {"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990021.000021\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_21\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nOOO: I'm out Thursday-Friday. Northstar Media is covered by Jordan if anything urgent comes up."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990030.000030\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_30\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nZenith Platforms contract fully executed ✅ Handing off to CS now."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990024.000024\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_24\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nRiverside Insurance just posted a LinkedIn job for a 'Platform Manager' — good upsell signal!"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990009.000009\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_09\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nNew competitive intel doc posted in #competitive. Ironridge is offering 20% discount to steal accounts."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990013.000013\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_13\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nHarbourview Capital: champion just left the company 😬 Need to re-map the account"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990008.000008\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_08\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nCascade Analytics came back from procurement — they're asking for net-60 terms"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990011.000011\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_11\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nWho owns the Silverstone Group account? Need to coordinate on renewal timing."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990040.000040\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_40\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nNew pricing deck is live — v3.2. All previous versions deprecated, please update your decks."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990042.000042\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_42\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nTerrace Software close call Friday! Getting the MSA signed before Q1 ends."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990020.000020\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_20\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nMeadowbrook Tech delayed decision to Q2 — board didn't approve new software spend this quarter"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990035.000035\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_35\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nFoxridge Capital — legal pushed back on the liability cap. Anyone dealt with this before?"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990034.000034\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_34\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nReminder: all deals >$50k need second-level approval. Submit in Salesforce before EOD."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990037.000037\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_37\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nUpdated security questionnaire template posted in Google Drive. Check #sales-enablement."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990022.000022\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_22\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nOceanfront Labs is doing a PoC. Week 2 check-in call went well — they love the API."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990016.000016\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_16\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nBayside Analytics is evaluating us vs. Competitor X. Request for a third reference call."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990045.000045\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_45\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nIronridge is back! After 6 weeks dark they replied to the breakup email. Scheduling a call."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990006.000006\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_06\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nBlueStar Ventures just signed the NDA — moving to discovery this week"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990005.000005\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_05\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nAnyone have a good champion letter template for manufacturing accounts?"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990007.000007\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_07\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nPSA: CRM maintenance Saturday 2-4am. Save your work Friday night."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990015.000015\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_15\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nWeek 9 leaderboard just posted. Three of us are over 130% — great work everyone!"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990050.000050\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_50\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nMaplecrest Systems sent us an unsolicited security questionnaire — anyone know this account?"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990012.000012\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_12\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nCloudBridge Systems is requesting a technical deep-dive on security architecture. Need an SE for March 8"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990049.000049\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_49\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nWeek 10 starts Monday. Let's sprint to close! Who needs backup on any deals?"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990002.000002\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_02\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nJust wrapped the Ironclad demo. Really engaged team, feels like a solid Proposal push."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990036.000036\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_36\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nOceanfront Labs pilot complete — 9/10 satisfaction. Moving to full deployment next month 🎉"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990018.000018\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_18\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nFoxridge Capital: verbal yes from the CFO. Contract coming this week!"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990043.000043\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_43\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nStonebridge Holdings asked for a multi-year price lock. Escalating to pricing committee."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990028.000028\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_28\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nUpland Systems ghosted for 3 weeks. Sent breakup email. Sometimes that works 😅"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990033.000033\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_33\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nSunstone Capital agreed to a 2-year deal at 8% discount. Checking with VP before countersigning."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990003.000003\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_03\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nReminder: pipeline review call at 3pm today. Please update your opps before then."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990027.000027\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_27\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nTerrace Software asked for implementation timeline — sending over SOW template today"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990025.000025\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_25\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nStonebridge Holdings legal review complete — moving to final approval. Should close by Friday."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990001.000001\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_01\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nMorning all! Big week ahead — let's close Q1 strong 💪"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990038.000038\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_38\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nAnyone have a warm contact at Northstar Media? Need an intro for the media vertical."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990017.000017\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_17\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nClearwater Systems legal is asking about SOC 2 Type II — grabbing report from InfoSec"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990014.000014\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_14\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nGood news: Alpine Digital signed! 2-year deal, $110k ARR. Nicely done Kevin!"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990004.000004\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_04\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nCongrats to Megan on closing Thornwood Partners! 🎉 $95k ARR"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990019.000019\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_19\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nHighpoint Consulting wants a custom integration quote. Looping in Solutions team."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990032.000032\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_32\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nCan someone share the latest competitive battle card? Need it before my Northgate call."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990048.000048\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_48\", \"channel_id\": \"C_RENEW\"}\nMeadowbrook Tech rescheduled again — Q2 for sure. Marking as delayed in CRM."}
